decision_discussion: Retain as research only; do not recommend the current shared-S one-row root mechanism as a uniform paper enhancement. The common-first-moment family is valid, strictly stronger than isolated GD, and supplies clear reoptimized LP information on every saved diagnostic domain. K35 adds useful final bound/gap information at a small incumbent cost. However, the serious RB35 incumbent/signed-gap regression fails the required retention question and is not offset by its small L gain. Keep the default-off implementation and reproducible evidence as a completed research result. Preserve R147 standalone D as its previously limited paper candidate and R137 as the stable default. Do not replace defaults or merge automatically.
complete_discussion:
The same-new-PE K35 pair gives a real bound/incumbent tradeoff. D returns U/L .676798845196/.545729444783; the candidate returns .679917519727/.558283855657. Supported L rises .012554410874 (2.300483%), physical U is .003118674531 worse (.460798%), and relative gap falls from 19.366079% to 17.889473% (-1.476606 percentage points). The signed gap falls .009435736343. Both remain open. Their accepted T_total values are 2378.764522/2379.834894s; this 1.070373s difference is not convergence or certification speed. The complete comparison justified one RB35 pressure pair, not promotion.

RB35-T2 answers that pressure question adversely. D returns U/L .335883588950/.219663876370; the candidate returns .371420783400/.220898439927. L rises only .001234563557 (.562024%), while physical U is .035537194450 worse (10.580212%). The signed gap grows from .116219712580 to .150522343473 (+.034302630893, about 29.52%); relative gap grows from 34.601188% to 40.526096% (+5.924908 percentage points). Both remain open. The accepted complete totals are 2378.591470/2379.626412s; their small difference is not a speed result. This is a serious regression under the inherited double-open rule: U loss exceeds max(.001,5% of D U), and signed-gap loss exceeds max(.005,25% of D signed gap).

All four formal arms retain their full cap2400 windows, complete independent own H and Seed0/Threads1. The candidate pays its normal root, construction/transport and one added root LP. Both roles have zero committed outer splits; Native target/search paths, Work, simplex and nodes remain separate observations. K35 initial LP increases .204187028164 to .209568159043, whereas printed Native root-after-cuts values are .44681/.44808. RB35 own-root LP increases .135292103721 to .1365597514 (rounded log value). These layers do not imply a monotone final search bound or incumbent. Native/trajectory changes locate observed gains and losses, without uniquely attributing them to a static row, a particular branch or AM. Candidate final U is worse on both roles, so neither candidate trajectory ever beats the corresponding D final U; saved committed trajectories retain the chronology.
scope_discussion: This closes the tested uniform one-row/one-added-own-root-LP implementation direction, not the entire mathematical common-S family. Two known Seed0 hard-role pairs are a finite selection study, not broad validation or a robustness claim. K20/RX20 complete proof pairs, extra seeds, more root cuts, high-deviation variants, RN/STOCK combinations and AM parameter rescues are not needed to overturn the observed important RB35 loss and are not queued. Unused experimental capacity is not unfinished work. The optional AM/no-strict information-retention question remains a separate possible future study; historical R47/R52 negative anchors and prior threshold experiments remain intact and are not rerun here.
paper_conclusion_tex: The common-first-moment rows improve all five matched LP values. In complete own-H search, K35 supported L improves 2.3005\% with a 0.4608\% worse physical U, reducing relative gap by 1.4766 percentage points. RB35 instead has a 10.5802\% worse U and only a 0.5620\% higher L; its relative gap rises by 5.9249 percentage points. Both pairs remain open. The latter serious incumbent/signed-gap regression rules out promotion of this uniform one-row root implementation. We retain the construction and LP evidence as a research result, preserve the limited standalone-D candidate and stable R137 version, and do not open a high-deviation, RN, STOCK or AM rescue grid. These observations do not invalidate the affine family or establish performance over unseen instances or seeds.
candidate: Standalone D + one own-root common-S low affine/moment row
